evidence.title: DSS Pro - Resources for Design Systems & Product Design

name: Design Systems Surf
summary: Database of real design systems and component references, plus guides, articles and paid products.
description: A database of best-in-class design systems, organized and sorted by components and directories: entries link each company's system (Apple HIG, Google Material, Microsoft Fluent, Adobe Spectrum, Atlassian and more) and component pages count how many systems ship a given piece (button, tabs, checkbox, switch, text field ...). Guides, articles and AI-ready products cover foundations, tokens and maintenance; Pro membership adds full access.
contains: database of design systems organized by components and directories
component pages: button, tabs, checkbox, switch, text field ...
foundations guides: color, typography, spacing, elevation, design tokens
AI-ready products and Pro membership from $8.25
